clauses.evidence: 'target slot (cast): 1..1 of [you_bear, you_giant, opp_flier, opp_tapped, opp_bear, opp_giant]' (any creature). Every [cast targets=[X]] variant, with the may answered fire or skip: 'X moves battlefield -> graveyard (by card/DESTROY)', 'X dies'. Sorcery carrier.

clauses.clause: You may search your library and/or graveyard for a card named Liliana, Death Mage, reveal it, and put it into your hand.
clauses.evidence: Trace shows the optional ('ask may: [fire, skip]') but no Liliana, Death Mage exists on the standard board. Packs: lilianas_scorn_finds_liliana_in_graveyard (fire: Liliana graveyard -> hand, the target destroyed) PASS; lilianas_scorn_decline_search_still_destroys (skip: target destroyed, Liliana stays in the library) PASS. The library half is already covered by tools/scenarios/lilianas_scorn_cast_destroys_and_searches.json.
clauses.issue: SEARCH uses SelectorMode.ONE_OF (exactly one) where the compiler's B4-tutor-liliana uses CHOOSE (up to one): a hidden-zone search may fail to find (CR 701.19b), so this removes an option only; the whole search is already optional, so not stronger. Same convention as this wave's Basri's Aegis packet.

clauses.clause: If you search your library this way, shuffle.
clauses.evidence: SHUFFLE(your library) sits inside the optional search, after SEARCH and REVEAL. Pack lilianas_scorn_decline_search_still_destroys PASS: with the search declined the library order is exactly unchanged (no shuffle without a search). Scratch control (not a spec pack): with fire the library order changes, so the shuffle runs when you search. A shuffled order cannot be asserted from the text, so no pack checks the permutation.
clauses.issue: The engine always searches both zones when you search, so 'graveyard only, no shuffle' is not available: weaker only.
